dm_single:
سلام! مرسی که کامنت گذاشتی 😊

6 پرامپت آماده‌ی ایمیل 👇
جای کروشه‌ها رو پر کن.

1. از یادداشت به ایمیل:
"Turn these notes into a clear, polite email to [who]. Goal: [what I want them to do]. Under 120 words. Notes: [paste]"
2. لحن:
"Rewrite this email to sound [warm but professional]. Keep all facts, dates and numbers the same: [paste]"
3. کوتاه‌تر:
"Cut this email by half. Keep every request and deadline, and put the main request in the first two lines: [paste]"
4. موضوع ایمیل:
"Write 5 clear subject lines for this email, each under 8 words: [paste]"
5. پیگیری:
"Write a short, polite follow-up to this email I sent [5] days ago with no reply: [paste]"
6. جواب به ایمیل سخت:
"Draft a calm reply to this email. Acknowledge their point, state my position: [position], and suggest a next step: [paste]"

راهنمای گوگل برای پرامپت: workspace.google.com/resources/ai/writing-effective-prompts
